name: Adestra
description: Let agents draft email campaigns in Adestra: find projects and campaigns, write the subject line and content, and send the campaign to your approvers. Agents never launch a campaign to a list. For staging campaigns and invitations for people to review.
identity: An Adestra API token. It acts as the Adestra user who created it, with that user's workspaces and access rights, so make a user for agents with only the workspaces they need.

setup.title: Make a user for agents
setup.body: An API token acts as the user who creates it. Make a separate Adestra user for agents, give it read and write API access and only the workspaces agents should draft in. Ask Adestra support to turn on API access for the user if the option is missing.

setup.title: Create an API token
setup.body: Sign in to Adestra as the agents' user. You can test the token with the command below: it shows the user the token belongs to and changes nothing.
click: Select your user icon in the title bar to open your user panel.
Press Create new API token, enter a name such as Agents and, if you like, a description.
Press Create and copy the new token.

capabilities.label: Read campaigns
capabilities.description: Find projects and campaigns, and read a campaign's details, options such as the subject line and sender, and its HTML or text content.
capabilities.note: Reaches every project and campaign the agents' user can see, unless you keep a key to chosen projects under API keys. Read-only.

capabilities.label: Draft campaigns
capabilities.description: Create campaigns, rename them or change their list, set options such as the subject line and sender, and write their HTML or text content.
capabilities.note: Can change any campaign the agents' user can edit, including ones people wrote. Nothing here launches a campaign.

capabilities.label: Ask for approval
capabilities.description: Send a campaign to one of your Adestra approval groups for review.
capabilities.note: Approvers decide whether it is launched. Agents cannot ask for it to be launched once approved.

capabilities.label: Send test emails
capabilities.description: Email a test of a campaign to chosen addresses.
capabilities.note: A test is a real email. Keep a key to your own team's addresses under API keys.

limits.label: Projects
limits.help: Optional: only these Adestra projects (their ids) when finding and creating campaigns and reading a campaign's details. A campaign's options and content, and changes to a campaign by its id, are not checked against this. Leave empty for every project.

limits.label: Test email addresses
limits.help: Optional: the only addresses tests may be sent to. Leave empty for any address.

revoke: In Adestra, open the agents' user panel, select Manage API tokens and delete the token. Agents lose access to Adestra at once.

tools.name: adestra_list_projects
tools.description: List Adestra projects (which hold campaigns), or only those in one workspace or with a name.

name.description: Only projects with exactly this name
name.name: search:name

page.description: Page of results, from 1 (250 per page)
page.name: paging:page

tools.name: adestra_search_campaigns
tools.description: Find campaigns in a project, by name, or by whether they were launched.

name.description: Only campaigns with exactly this name
name.name: search:name

launched.description: Only launched (true) or not yet launched (false) campaigns
launched.name: search:launched

tools.name: adestra_get_campaign
tools.description: Read one campaign: name, project, list, subject line and whether it was published or launched.

tools.name: adestra_get_campaign_options
tools.description: Read a campaign's options, such as subject line, sender and reply names and addresses, and unsubscribe list.

tools.name: adestra_get_message
tools.description: Read a campaign's HTML or text content.

tools.name: adestra_create_campaign
tools.description: Create a campaign in a project. It is not launched; set its options and content next.

project_id.description: The project to create it in

list_id.description: The list it will go to

apply_user_defaults.description: Apply the user's campaign preferences and presets
apply_user_defaults.name: options:apply_user_defaults

tools.name: adestra_update_campaign
tools.description: Rename a campaign, change its description or the list it will go to. Values left out stay as they are.

tools.name: adestra_set_campaign_option
tools.description: Set the campaign's subject line, sender name or reply name.

tools.name: adestra_set_message
tools.description: Write a campaign's HTML or text content, replacing what is there.

tools.name: adestra_request_approval
tools.description: Send a campaign to an approval group for review. Approvers are told when notify_approvers is true.

threshold.description: Approvals needed; left out, everyone in the group must approve

notify_approvers.description: Email the group's members about the request

tools.name: adestra_send_test
tools.description: Email a test of a campaign to one or more addresses.

emails.description: Addresses to send the test to
